newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota sees 97/98 parent operating profit Y570 bln.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sees 97/98 parent operating profit Y570 bln.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to achieve a parent operating profit of 570 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1998.
Japan's biggest carmaker also said in a statement that it plans parent capital investment in the year of 320 billion yen.
Toyota forecast domestic sales of 2.24 million units in 1997/98, up 0.4 percent from the previous year. It said it also expects its vehicle exports to rise 6.7 percent to 1.4 million units.
Toyota said its overseas production would rise 10.2 percent to 1.52 million units.
Company vice president Iwao Isomura told a news conference that exports to the United States were expected to remain flat for the year, but gave no specific figures.
